title: conyza lechleri
intro: Conyza lechleri, commonly known as Andean mint or Tumbado, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Conyza lechleri are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Conyza lechleri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
